definitions.short: a ringlet of hair (as gliding over each other)
definitions.full: H4253. machalaphah [ מַחֲלָפָה ] noun feminine plait (of hair; so called from intertwining, passing through each other, of the strands) — Plural construct ראֹשִׁי מַחְלְפוֺת Judg 16:13 , compare 16:19 .

occurrences.englishText: Delilah said to Samson, “Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound.”
She made him sleep on her knees; and she called for a man and shaved off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
